To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the IT governance mechanisms of IT planning, IT architecture, IT organization, and IT management are positively and significantly related to the strategic alignment of IT and the business and, further, that strategic alignment is positively and significantly related (fully mediating the effects of IT governance mechanisms) to organizational performance.
IT governance mechanisms have an impact on strategic alignment, which in turn affects organizational performance.
IT governance mechanisms and organizational performance are positively related, and this relationship is fully mediated by IT strategic alignment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of IT governance in the creation of business value through strategic alignment.
how information technology governance mechanisms and strategic IT alignment influence organizational performance.
how information technology governance mechanisms and strategic alignments influence organizational performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IT governance mechanisms are positively related to strategic alignment, which in turn is positively related to organizational performance.
the more effectively IT governance mechanisms are used to support organizational strategy, the better is organizational performance.
the strategic alignment of IT and business strategies is the key to the successful use of information technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IT governance mechanisms are positively associated with organizational performance, and that this relationship is mediated by strategic alignment.
the effectiveness of IT management depends on the alignment of the IT strategy to the business strategy.
IT governance mechanisms and the alignment between IT and the business strategy are both important for achieving organizational performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IT governance mechanisms and their effects on organizational performance are fully mediated by strategic alignments.
IT governance mechanisms and alignment should be considered together when assessing organizational performance.
IT governance mechanisms and the alignment of IT and business strategy are both critical for achieving organizational performance.
